stops.stop: Paris, in the room for Cogito et histoire de la folie
stops.date_confidence: [A] the lecture at the College philosophique on 4 March 1963, with Foucault present, is attested (Wikipedia, 'Michel Foucault'; Wikipedia, 'Cogito and the History of Madness'; Derrida, 'Cogito et histoire de la folie', collected in L'ecriture et la difference, 1967). The coordinate is inherited byte-identical from the same stop in jacques_derrida.journey.json, which is the pool's pin for the College philosophique and is not verified against a street address. [A] Foucault's reply is dated 1972: 'Reponse a Derrida' in the Japanese journal Paideia no. 11, 1 February 1972, and 'Mon corps, ce papier, ce feu', a longer version of the same argument, carried in the 1972 Gallimard edition of the book. Contradiction left standing: some accounts call both pieces appendices to that edition, while the Cairn.info collation puts only 'Mon corps, ce papier, ce feu' in the volume, as Appendix II beside 'La folie, l'absence d'oeuvre'. [A] Jean Khalfa states the two stopped communicating for ten years; the campa's 'better part of a decade' is deliberately looser than the round number.

stops.stop: Paris, the rue d'Ulm, called into Lacan's seminar
stops.date_confidence: [A] attested to the day: the session of 18 May 1966 of Lacan's Seminaire XIII, L'objet de la psychanalyse, is built on the Las Meninas chapter of Les Mots et les choses, with Foucault present. The pin is the corpus value for 45 rue d'Ulm, shared byte-identical with jacques_lacan.journey.json; the research pool proposed 48.8413 / 2.3454

stops.stop: Paris, the College de France, Qu'est-ce qu'un auteur?
stops.date_confidence: [A] attested to the day and the hour: the Societe francaise de philosophie opens at 4.45 pm on 22 February 1969 in salle 6 of the College de France, Jean Wahl presiding, with Lacan, Jean Ullmo, Maurice de Gandillac, Lucien Goldmann and Jean d'Ormesson present; lecture and discussion in the Bulletin de la Societe francaise de philosophie 63:3, juillet-septembre 1969, pp. 73-104. [A] this is not a College de France course: he holds no chair there yet and is elected fourteen months later, and it is not the Sorbonne, where the same society heard Derrida in 1968. The pin is this file's College de France value, shared byte-identical with jacques_lacan.journey.json; the research pool proposed 48.8489 / 2.3455
